description: This Java class defines a write model for deleting a 'Thing' in a MongoDB collection, encapsulating the logic to create a delete update operation based on provided metadata.

classes.name: ThingDeleteModel
classes.description: Immutable class extending AbstractWriteModel to represent a delete operation for a 'Thing' in MongoDB, with a factory method 'of' for instantiation and 'toMongo' for generating the MongoDB update operation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance of ThingDeleteModel from Metadata.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Converts this delete model into a MongoDB WriteModel (UpdateOneModel) that performs the deletion by setting the delete timestamp, bypassing document validation.
